nodes.label:
The metaphor
• Constellation = GitHub user
• Star system = repo
   (colour = language, size = repo size,
    brightness = last push, glow = stars)
• Planet = directory · Moon = file
• Flares = weekly commit activity
• Trade lane = import (on demand)

Request budget (60/hr, no token)
• Constellation: 2 calls
• Fly into a repo: 1 tree + 1 activity
• → ~25 repo dives per hour
• Cached repeats (< 1 hr): 0 calls
• With a token: 5,000/hr + free ETag 304s

fields.name: avatar_url
fields.description: Shown at the centre of the constellation

models.name: Repo
models.description: A star system. From GET /users/:login/repos (one call, up to 100 repos).

fields.name: fork
fields.description: Forks drawn as faint companion stars

models.name: Directory
models.description: A planet. Built from the recursive git tree.

models.name: FileEntry
models.description: A moon. A blob from GET /repos/:o/:r/git/trees/:branch?recursive=1.

models.name: ImportEdge
models.description: A trade lane. On demand only: parsed from raw file contents when you click a planet.

models.name: CacheEntry
models.description: One cached GitHub response in IndexedDB. Fresh entries (< 1 hr) skip the network entirely; with a token, ETag 304s are also free.

fields.name: token
fields.description: Optional PAT, stored ONLY in this browser, never sent anywhere but api.github.com
